narrative.overview: The public website expresses a berry artifact studio: oversized neutral type, warm paper and scattered authored specimens connect the offset-field mark to a spacious editorial public face. The app retains its quiet working interface. Artifacts stay visually primary inside the app; berry marks deliberate actions. This is a Go-backed product with a bilingual interface, not a static UI proposal.
keyCharacteristics: Light and dark themes with independently scoped website surfaces

rules.name: The Action Contrast Rule
rules.body: Keep the brand accent distinct from the app's text-safe action shades; use `--star`, `--on-star`, `--star-edge` and `--star-hover` together. Kit v5 shares those app tokens. Released kit v1–v4 remain immutable and do not inherit the berry update.

dos: Do keep product prose and headings named CodeXArtifacts.
Do keep lowercase `pictor` API/settings identifiers compatible where documented.
Do respect reduced motion and both light/dark themes.
Do preserve sandbox, sharing and browser focus behavior during visual work.
Do label illustration as illustration; do not invent usage or acceptance claims.
donts: Don't introduce the paused TS/Cloudflare architecture into this release.
